meaning.en: Om; the point of radiance
the highest meditation
resting in the heart of the universal Self
atom-fine, of Shiva, peaceful
the coarse, the fine, and what is beyond
meaning.hi: स्थूल, सूक्ष्म और जो उनसे परे है

meaning.en: full of hardship and hard to worship
meaning.hi: कष्टपूर्ण और कठिनाई से आराधने योग्य

meaning.en: hard to see, free, imperishable
that meditation itself is rare
even for sages and thinkers
meaning.hi: मुनियों और मनीषियों के लिए भी

meaning.en: measured in eating
master of anger, of clinging, of the senses
meaning.hi: क्रोध, आसक्ति और इन्द्रियों का विजेता

meaning.en: free of opposites, free of ego
without cravings, without hoarding
he who makes the unreachable reachable
meaning.hi: जो अगम्य को गम्य बनाता है

meaning.en: whose mind does not go after the reachable
meaning.hi: जिसका मन सुलभ वस्तुओं के पीछे नहीं जाता

meaning.en: at the entrance they find three
meaning.hi: मुख पर वे तीन को पाते हैं

meaning.en: the one of three abodes is called the Swan
meaning.hi: तीन धाम वाला हंस कहलाता है

meaning.en: know it as supreme, most secret
free of drowsiness, without support
a subtle digit of the moon's form
that is Vishnu's highest abode
meaning.hi: वह विष्णु का परम पद है

meaning.en: the place with three faces and three qualities
meaning.hi: तीन मुख और तीन गुणों वाला स्थान

meaning.en: of three elements, yet formless
meaning.hi: तीन धातुओं वाला, फिर भी रूपरहित

meaning.en: unmoving and free of mental division
shapeless and without support
the place free of limiting adjuncts
beyond the range of speech and mind
meaning.hi: वाणी और मन की पहुँच से परे

meaning.en: one's own nature, grasped by inner feeling
meaning.hi: अपना स्वभाव, भाव से ग्रहण करने योग्य

meaning.en: not compounded, beyond every position
beyond both joy and the absence of joy
meaning.hi: आनन्द और अनानन्द दोनों से परे

meaning.en: hard to see, liberation, imperishable
thinkable thus, yet free of thought
meaning.hi: ऐसे चिन्तनीय, फिर भी उससे मुक्त

meaning.en: eternal, fixed, never slipping
that is Brahman's, that is the inner Self
meaning.hi: वह ब्रह्म का है, वह अध्यात्म है

meaning.en: that is Vishnu's highest refuge
meaning.hi: वह विष्णु का परम आश्रय है

meaning.en: unthinkable, a self of pure awareness
which abides as the supreme space
meaning.hi: जो परम आकाश के रूप में स्थित है

meaning.en: not empty, yet of the nature of emptiness
beyond emptiness, set in the heart
meaning.hi: शून्य से परे, हृदय में स्थित

words.sanskrit: na dhyanam ca na ca dhyata

meaning.en: neither meditation nor meditator
nor object, yet it is the object
meaning.hi: न ध्येय, फिर भी वही ध्येय

meaning.en: it is all, yet not the supreme void
meaning.hi: यह सब है, पर परम शून्य नहीं

meaning.en: not the highest, nor beyond the highest
meaning.hi: न पर, न पर से भी पर

meaning.en: unthinkable and not an object of waking
they know it as neither 'real' nor 'supreme'
meaning.hi: उसे न सत्य न पर जानते हैं

meaning.en: united with the sages
neither gods nor others know it
meaning.hi: न देवता न अन्य उसे जानते हैं

meaning.en: greed, delusion, fear, arrogance
desire, anger and sin
cold and heat, hunger and thirst
resolving and doubting
no pride in priestly lineage
no heap of knots about liberation
meaning.hi: मुक्ति की गाँठों का संचय नहीं

meaning.en: no fear, no pleasure, no pain
meaning.hi: न भय, न सुख, न दुःख

meaning.en: likewise of honour and insult
meaning.hi: वैसे ही मान और अपमान का

meaning.en: released from these states
that Brahman, the highest, is to be grasped
meaning.hi: वह परब्रह्म ग्रहण करने योग्य है

meaning.en: restraint, observance, renunciation
silence, place and time
posture and the root lock
evenness of body and steadiness of gaze
and regulation of the breath
sense-withdrawal and concentration
meditation on the Self and absorption
these are declared the limbs, in order
meaning.hi: ये क्रम से अंग कहे गए हैं

meaning.en: from the knowledge that all is Brahman
meaning.hi: सब ब्रह्म है, इस ज्ञान से

meaning.en: restraint of the host of senses
this is declared to be yama
to be practised again and again
a flow of thoughts of the same kind
rejection of unlike thoughts
niyama is indeed supreme bliss
is practised by the wise
renunciation of the world-form
by seeing the Self as being and awareness
such renunciation is honoured by the great
meaning.hi: ऐसा त्याग महानों द्वारा पूज्य है

meaning.en: granting liberation at once
from which words turn back
not reaching it, along with the mind
that silence reachable by yogis
meaning.hi: वह मौन जो योगियों को प्राप्य है

meaning.en: the wise should always resort to it
since words turn back from it
meaning.hi: क्योंकि वाणी उससे लौट आती है

meaning.en: by whom can it be spoken
if the world is to be described
meaning.hi: यदि प्रपञ्च का वर्णन करना हो

meaning.en: that too is devoid of words
meaning.hi: वह भी शब्दों से रहित है

meaning.en: in this way that becomes silence
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार वह मौन होता है

meaning.en: all that is called innate
silence of speech is for children
meaning.hi: वाणी का मौन बालकों के लिए है

meaning.en: unfit for knowers of Brahman
at the beginning, end and middle
in which no person is found
meaning.hi: जिसमें कोई जन नहीं पाया जाता

meaning.en: by which all this is ever pervaded
meaning.hi: जिससे यह सब सदा व्याप्त है

meaning.en: that is called the solitary place
meaning.hi: वह विजन देश कहा गया है

meaning.en: the imagined making of all beings
from Brahma onward, in a blink
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा आदि की, निमेष भर में

meaning.en: what is indicated by the word time
is the undivided, non-dual bliss
in which there is ease
unbroken contemplation of Brahman
know that as the posture
any other destroys ease
meaning.hi: अन्य सुख को नष्ट करता है

meaning.en: for accomplishment, the origin of all beings
meaning.hi: सिद्धि हेतु, सब प्राणियों का आदि

meaning.en: the non-dual ground of the universe
in which the perfected attained perfection
that is called siddhasana
that which is the root of all worlds
meaning.hi: जो सब लोकों का मूल है

meaning.en: that which is the root of the mind's bondage
meaning.hi: जो चित्त के बन्धन का मूल है

meaning.en: the root lock is always to be practised
it is fit for knowers of Brahman
know evenness of the limbs
as dissolving into the even Brahman
otherwise there is no evenness
only straightness like a dry tree
making the gaze full of knowledge
one should see the world as Brahman
that vision is most noble
not gazing at the nose-tip
meaning.hi: नासिका के अग्रभाग को देखने वाली नहीं

meaning.en: of the seer, the seeing and the seen
where there is a cessation
there alone should the gaze be fixed
not on the tip of the nose
in all states beginning with the mind
by contemplating them as Brahman
the stilling of all mental movements
that is called pranayama
negation of the world-display
is called exhalation

words.sanskrit: brahma eva asmi iti ya vrittih

meaning.en: the thought 'I am Brahman alone'
is called the in-breath
then the steadiness of that thought
is kumbhaka, the control of breath
and this is for the awakened
meaning.hi: और यह प्रबुद्धों के लिए है

meaning.en: for the ignorant, pressing the nose
seeing the Self in sense objects
delighting the mind
that is to be known as pratyahara
to be practised again and again
wherever the mind goes
by seeing Brahman there
and so holding the mind
meaning.hi: और मन को ऐसे धारण करना

meaning.en: that is held to be the highest concentration
meaning.hi: वह परम धारणा मानी गई है

meaning.en: by the true thought 'I am Brahman alone'
meaning.hi: 'मैं ब्रह्म ही हूँ' इस सद्वृत्ति से

meaning.en: abiding without any support
is known by the word meditation
giver of supreme bliss
by a thought free of change
then by its taking Brahman's form
complete forgetting of the thought
is called samadhi
and this unartificial bliss
one should practise well so long
until, in an instant, for the seeker, the goal
meaning.hi: जब तक क्षण भर में साधक का लक्ष्य

meaning.en: the inward Self arises by itself
then, freed from the means
the king of yogis becomes accomplished
that becomes his own true form
meaning.hi: वह उसका अपना स्वरूप होता है

meaning.en: beyond the field of mind and speech
meaning.hi: मन और वाणी के विषय से परे

meaning.en: while samadhi is being practised
obstacles come with force
lack of steady inquiry
laziness, craving for pleasure
drowsiness, darkness and distraction
inner lights, sweating and blankness
thus a multitude of obstacles
to be abandoned by experts in Brahman
by thought of things, thingness
by thought of void, voidness
by thought of Brahman, fullness
by it, practise fullness
those who abandon this thought
called Brahman, purifying, supreme
they indeed live in vain
such people are like animals
meaning.hi: ऐसे मनुष्य पशुओं के समान हैं

meaning.en: but those who know this thought
meaning.hi: पर जो इस वृत्ति को जानते हैं

meaning.en: and having known, increase it
they are truly good and blessed
meaning.hi: वे सचमुच सत्पुरुष और धन्य हैं

meaning.en: worthy of honour in the three worlds
those whose thought is even and grown
meaning.hi: जिनकी वृत्ति सम और बढ़ी हुई है

meaning.en: and has fully ripened
meaning.hi: और फिर पूरी तरह पक गई है

meaning.en: they attain the state of Brahman
meaning.hi: वे ब्रह्मभाव को प्राप्त होते हैं

meaning.en: not others who merely talk
skilled in talk about Brahman
without the inner thought, deeply attached
they too, through ignorance, surely
meaning.hi: वे भी अज्ञान के कारण निश्चित ही

meaning.en: come again and go
they do not stay even half a blink
without the Brahman-filled thought
just as Brahma and others remain
Sanaka and others, Shuka and others
that whose effect exists is a cause
meaning.hi: जिसका कार्य है वह कारण है

meaning.en: its cause appears in it
meaning.hi: उसका कारण उसमें प्रकट होता है

meaning.en: the cause in truth vanishes
meaning.hi: कारण तत्त्वतः नष्ट हो जाता है

meaning.en: when inquiry shows no effect
meaning.hi: विचार से कार्य के अभाव में

meaning.en: then the pure reality remains
meaning.hi: तब शुद्ध वस्तु शेष रहती है

meaning.en: which is beyond the range of words
meaning.hi: जो वाणी की पहुँच से परे है

meaning.en: arises in the pure-minded
meaning.hi: शुद्ध चित्त वालों में उदित होता है

meaning.en: knowledge as thought, then the supreme
contemplated with intense force
the reality of firm conviction
making the visible invisible
one should contemplate it as Brahman
the wise should always abide in happiness
meaning.hi: ज्ञानी सदा सुख में स्थित रहे

meaning.en: with the intellect
full of the essence of awareness
then Kumara asked Shiva
meaning.hi: तब कुमार ने शिव से पूछा

the supreme Shiva said
the seen, the world, are of one unbroken flavour
meaning.hi: दृश्य और जगत अखण्ड एकरस हैं

meaning.en: feeling, and oneself, are of that one flavour
meaning.hi: भाव और स्वयं अखण्ड एकरस हैं

the goal is of that essence

the mind is of that essence
the deeper mind is of that essence
happiness is of that essence
knowledge is of one unbroken essence
the imperishable is of that essence
the eternal is of that essence
the supreme is of that essence
anything at all is of one unbroken essence
meaning.hi: जो कुछ भी है वह अखण्ड एकरस है

meaning.en: the supreme is of that essence
other than the one unbroken essence
there is nothing, nothing, O six-faced one
meaning.hi: नहीं है, नहीं है, हे षडानन

meaning.en: nothing exists apart from the one essence
meaning.hi: अखण्ड एकरस से अलग कुछ नहीं

meaning.en: truly not apart from it
whatever little there is, is from it
meaning.hi: जो कुछ है वह उसी से है

meaning.en: from that one essence am I
meaning.hi: मैं उसी अखण्ड एकरस से हूँ

meaning.en: the gross is of one unbroken essence
and the subtle is of undivided form
meaning.hi: और सूक्ष्म अखण्ड रूप वाला है

all the worlds are awareness

space, earth, water, air, fire
Brahma, Hari, Shiva

words.sanskrit: yat kincit yat na kincit ca

meaning.en: whatever is something and whatever is nothing
meaning.hi: जो कुछ है और जो कुछ नहीं है

meaning.en: all is indeed awareness alone
all that is of one unbroken essence
whatever it is, is awareness alone
meaning.hi: जो-जो है वह चिन्मात्र ही है

meaning.en: past, present and future
all is indeed awareness alone
substance and time are pure awareness
knowing and the known are awareness itself
meaning.hi: ज्ञान और ज्ञेय चित् ही हैं

meaning.en: and the knower has the form of awareness
all is indeed made of awareness
conversation is pure awareness
whatever is, is awareness alone
meaning.hi: जो-जो है वह चिन्मात्र ही है

meaning.en: the unreal and the real are awareness
beginning and end are ever made of awareness
meaning.hi: आदि और अन्त सदा चिन्मय हैं

meaning.en: beginning and end are pure awareness
teacher, student and the rest are made of awareness
if seer and seen are awareness
meaning.hi: यदि द्रष्टा और दृश्य चिन्मात्र हैं

meaning.en: whatever exists is ever made of awareness
meaning.hi: जो है वह सदा चिन्मय है

meaning.en: every wonder is pure awareness
the body is awareness alone
the subtle body and the causal body
do not exist apart from awareness
I and you are pure awareness
the formed, the formless and the rest are made of awareness
merit and sin are pure awareness
the soul has awareness as its body
apart from awareness there is no resolve
apart from awareness there is no feeling
apart from awareness there are no mantras and the like
meaning.hi: चिन्मात्र से अलग मन्त्र आदि नहीं

meaning.en: apart from awareness there is no deity
apart from awareness there are no guardians of the quarters
worldly dealings come from awareness
the supreme Brahman is awareness

words.sanskrit: cinmatrat na asti kah api hi

meaning.en: apart from awareness there is no one at all
meaning.hi: चिन्मात्र से अलग कोई भी नहीं

meaning.en: apart from awareness there is no maya
apart from awareness there is no worship
apart from awareness there is nothing to ponder
apart from awareness there is no truth
apart from awareness there are no sheaths
meaning.hi: चिन्मात्र से अलग कोश आदि नहीं

meaning.en: apart from awareness there is no wealth
apart from awareness there is no silence
apart from awareness there is no non-silence
apart from awareness there is no detachment
all is indeed awareness alone
whatever and however much is awareness
meaning.hi: जो और जितना है वह चिन्मात्र है

meaning.en: whatever and however much is seen
whatever and however far off
meaning.hi: जो और जितना दूर स्थित है

meaning.en: all is indeed awareness alone
whatever beings and elements there are
whatever can be pointed to
meaning.hi: जो कुछ भी लक्षित होता है

meaning.en: whatever and however much Vedanta there is
all is indeed awareness alone
apart from awareness there is no going
apart from awareness there is no liberation
apart from awareness there is no goal
all is indeed awareness alone
Brahman, the one unbroken essence

in scripture, in me, in you and in the Lord
meaning.hi: शास्त्र में, मुझमें, तुममें और ईश्वर में

meaning.en: you are the one unbroken essence
whoever, in this oneness of form
knows 'I am indeed this'
liberation comes by knowing once
meaning.hi: एक बार के ज्ञान से मुक्ति होती है

meaning.en: when knowledge is complete
he himself is the teacher
I am of the nature of the supreme Brahman
I am supreme bliss
I am knowledge alone
I am simply the highest
I am purely peace
I am purely made of awareness
I am purely the eternal
I am purely everlasting
I am purely of the nature of being
having given up 'I', I remain I
my nature is free of all
I am made of the sky of awareness
I am purely the fourth
I alone am beyond the fourth
I am ever of the nature of awareness
I am made of awareness and bliss
I am the sole form
I am ever pure in form
I am knowledge alone
I am the beloved itself
my nature is free of mental division
I am without craving, without illness
I am ever unattached by nature
I am changeless and imperishable
I am ever of one flavour
my body is ever pure awareness
my form is unbounded
I have the form of unbroken bliss
I am being and supreme bliss
I am awareness and supreme bliss
I am the innermost of the inner
meaning.hi: मैं अन्तर का भी अन्तर हूँ

meaning.en: beyond the range of speech and mind
my nature is the bliss of the Self
I am ever the true bliss
I am one who delights in the Self
for this Self is Sadashiva
I am self-luminous
I am the essence of the Self's light
I am without beginning, middle or end
I am like space
I am existence alone, eternal, pure, aware, blissful
meaning.hi: मैं नित्य, शुद्ध, चिदानन्द, सत्तामात्र हूँ

meaning.en: imperishable
ever awake, utterly pure, one
I am being-awareness-bliss
my nature is the eternal remainder
I am ever beyond all
my nature is beyond form
my body is the supreme space
my nature is the bliss of the infinite
I am ever beyond language
my nature is the ground of all
I am always solid awareness
I am free of the body-feeling
I am ever free of worry
I am free of the mind's waves
I am one essence with the conscious Self
meaning.hi: मैं चिदात्मा के साथ एकरस हूँ

meaning.en: I am devoid of all that is seen
I am indeed the nature of seeing
I am always complete
I am ever content
I am Brahman; I am all
meaning.hi: मैं ब्रह्म ही हूँ, सब मैं हूँ

meaning.en: I am awareness itself
I alone, I alone am
having the form of infinite space
I alone am the great Self
I alone am higher than the highest
I appear as if another
meaning.hi: मैं अन्य के समान भासता हूँ

meaning.en: I alone appear as a body
meaning.hi: मैं ही शरीर के समान हूँ

meaning.en: I appear like a disciple
meaning.hi: मैं शिष्य के समान भासता हूँ

meaning.en: this is the support of the three worlds
meaning.hi: यह तीनों लोकों का आश्रय है

meaning.en: I am beyond the three times
meaning.hi: मैं तीनों कालों से परे हूँ

meaning.en: I am worshipped by the Vedas
I am ascertained by scripture
I am established in the mind
nothing at all is left out by me
meaning.hi: मुझसे त्यक्त कुछ भी नहीं है

meaning.en: nor is the earth left out by me
whatever is other than me
meaning.hi: जो कुछ भी मुझसे अतिरिक्त है

words.sanskrit: tat tat na asti iti nishcinu

meaning.en: be certain that it does not exist
meaning.hi: निश्चय करो कि वह नहीं है

meaning.en: I am Brahman, I am accomplished

meaning.hi: मैं ब्रह्म ही हूँ, चित् ही हूँ

meaning.en: I am the highest; no doubt
meaning.hi: मैं परम हूँ; कोई संशय नहीं

meaning.en: he himself is the swan, by himself
by himself he stands in himself
by himself he sees himself
lives happily in the kingdom of his own Self
meaning.hi: अपनी आत्मा के राज्य में सुख से बसे

meaning.en: he himself enjoys the bliss of his own Self
meaning.hi: स्वयं अपनी आत्मा का आनन्द भोगे

meaning.en: he is called liberated while living
he alone is the single hero in front
meaning.hi: वही सबसे आगे अकेला वीर है

meaning.en: he alone is remembered as lord
become Brahman, deeply at peace
made of the bliss of Brahman, happy
clear in form, the great silent one
he is bodiless; truly free
the Self of all, the Self the same everywhere
the pure Self; I have risen
meaning.hi: शुद्ध आत्मा; मैं उठ गया हूँ

meaning.en: free of 'one', the single Self
nothing but my own Self
I am the unborn Self and the deathless Self
meaning.hi: मैं अजन्मा और अमृत आत्मा हूँ

meaning.en: I am the self-existent Self, undecaying
I am the Self that is the target, the graceful Self
silent, abiding in the Self's own nature
the Self that is bliss; the Self is dear indeed
the Self that is freedom, free of bondage

words.sanskrit: brahma eva aham cid eva aham

meaning.en: I am Brahman alone, awareness alone
meaning.hi: मैं ब्रह्म ही, चित् ही हूँ

meaning.en: and even this is not thought about
meaning.hi: और ऐसा भी सोचा नहीं जाता

meaning.en: as awareness alone
whoever remains
bodiless
he is truly free
giving up even the conviction
the conviction 'I am Brahman'
whose heart is brimming with joy
meaning.hi: जिसका अन्तःकरण आनन्द से भरा है

meaning.en: he is bodiless, truly free

words.sanskrit: sarvam asti iti na asti iti

meaning.en: 'everything is', 'nothing is'
having dropped such convictions, he remains
meaning.hi: ऐसे निश्चय त्यागकर टिका रहता है

meaning.en: 'I am Brahman', 'I am not'
nothing but being, awareness, bliss
anything, anywhere, at any time
meaning.hi: कुछ भी, कहीं भी, कभी भी

meaning.en: does not touch the Self
he remains silent, silent
meaning.hi: वह मौन ही, मौन में स्थित है

meaning.en: silence is the truth, nothing else
meaning.hi: मौन ही सत्य है, और कुछ नहीं

meaning.en: the supreme Self, beyond the three qualities
the Self of all, who brings beings into being
meaning.hi: सबकी आत्मा, भूतों को उत्पन्न करने वाला

meaning.en: difference of time, difference of things
meaning.hi: काल का भेद, वस्तु का भेद

meaning.en: difference of place, difference within itself
meaning.hi: देश का भेद, अपने भीतर का भेद

meaning.en: not the slightest difference belongs to it
nor does anything else exist

words.sanskrit: aham tvam tad idam so ayam

meaning.en: I, you, that, this, he
the Self of time, yet without time
meaning.hi: काल की आत्मा, फिर भी काल से रहित

meaning.en: the empty Self, the Self of subtle form
meaning.hi: शून्य आत्मा, सूक्ष्म रूप वाली आत्मा

meaning.en: the Self of the universe, yet without the universe
meaning.hi: विश्व की आत्मा, फिर भी विश्व से रहित

meaning.en: the Self of the gods, yet without gods
meaning.hi: देवों की आत्मा, फिर भी देवों से रहित

meaning.en: the Self of the measurable, yet free of measure
meaning.hi: मेय की आत्मा, फिर भी मेय से रहित

meaning.en: the Self with nothing inert anywhere
the inner Self of all
the Self free of every intention
'I am awareness alone', always
I am the Supreme Self, alone
knowledge alone, given form
the Self whose nature is mere existence
nothing else: no world, no fear
meaning.hi: और कुछ नहीं: न जगत, न भय

meaning.en: 'the soul and the Lord'
'where is speech?'
'the Vedas, scriptures and so on', and 'I'
and even 'I am awareness'
whoever is empty of such convictions
meaning.hi: जो ऐसे निश्चयों से शून्य है

meaning.en: he is bodiless, truly free
fully established as awareness alone
delighting in his own Self, seated at ease
meaning.hi: स्वात्मा में रमता, सुख से आसीन

meaning.en: the Self of unbounded form
free of the atomic, the gross and so on
beyond even the fourth, the supreme bliss
meaning.hi: तुरीय से भी परे, परम आनन्द

meaning.en: he is bodiless, truly free
the Self without name and form
whose nature is the joy of supreme knowing
the Self whose form is beyond the fourth
meaning.hi: तुरीय से परे स्वरूप वाली आत्मा

meaning.en: free of auspicious and inauspicious
the Self that is yoga, the Self joined in yoga
free of bondage and liberation
the Self without qualities or their absence
meaning.hi: गुण और अगुण से रहित आत्मा

meaning.en: free of place, time and the rest
the Self without witnessed or witness-hood
meaning.hi: साक्ष्य और साक्षित्व से रहित आत्मा

meaning.en: not something, not something, nothing at all
meaning.hi: न कुछ, न कुछ, कुछ भी नहीं

meaning.en: for whom there is no appearance of the world
meaning.hi: जिसके लिए प्रपञ्च का आभास नहीं

meaning.en: not even the form of Brahman here
meaning.hi: यहाँ ब्रह्म का आकार भी नहीं

meaning.en: in his own nature, self-luminous
in his own nature, self-delighting
meaning.hi: अपने स्वरूप में स्वयं में रमा

meaning.en: a bliss beyond the range of words
meaning.hi: वाणी की पहुँच से परे आनन्द

meaning.en: himself the true field of speech and mind
meaning.hi: स्वयं वाणी और मन का विषय

meaning.en: whose state is beyond the beyond
meaning.hi: जिसकी अवस्था अतीत से भी अतीत है

meaning.en: he is bodiless, truly free
who is beyond the stirrings of the mind
meaning.hi: जो चित्त की वृत्तियों से परे है

meaning.en: who lights up those stirrings
meaning.hi: जो चित्तवृत्तियों को प्रकाशित करता है

meaning.en: the Self free of all mental stirrings
he is bodiless, truly free
at that time he is called bodiless
meaning.hi: उस समय वह विदेही कहलाता है

meaning.en: free of the memory of the body
if even a trace is remembered
then he is joined with everything
meaning.hi: तब वह सबसे जुड़ा होता है

meaning.en: his Self unseen by others in his outer form
meaning.hi: बाहरी रूप में दूसरों से अदृष्ट आत्मा

meaning.en: a solid mass of supreme bliss and awareness
his Self unseen by others in his outer form
meaning.hi: बाहरी रूप में दूसरों से अदृष्ट आत्मा

meaning.en: the subject of all Vedanta
who tastes the nectar-essence of Brahman
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म के अमृत-रस का स्वाद लेने वाला

meaning.en: whose tonic is the nectar of Brahman
devoted to the nectar of Brahman
himself the nectar of Brahman
immersed in the nectar of Brahman
whose worship of Shiva is Brahman's bliss
content in the nectar of Brahman
the one who experiences Brahman's bliss
whose joy in Shiva is Brahman's bliss
glowing with the essence of Brahman's bliss
the supreme light of Brahman's bliss
unbroken in Brahman's bliss
eater of the food that is Brahman's bliss
whose family is Brahman's bliss
mounted on the essence of Brahman's bliss
one solid mass of awareness that is Brahman's bliss
carried up by Brahman's bliss
brimming with Brahman's bliss
joined with people of Brahman's bliss
established in the Self that is Brahman's bliss
all this is the Self in form
meaning.hi: यह सब आत्मा का ही रूप है

meaning.en: nothing whatever other than the Self
meaning.hi: आत्मा से अन्य कुछ भी नहीं

meaning.en: all is the Self; I am the Self
meaning.hi: सब आत्मा है; मैं आत्मा हूँ

meaning.en: the supreme Self, whose nature is the beyond
the Self whose nature is eternal bliss
he is bodiless, truly free
of complete form, the great Self
the pleased Self, eternal
the Self as the inner controller of all
the stainless Self, without a separate self
meaning.hi: निर्मल आत्मा, निजी आत्मभाव से रहित

meaning.en: the Self whose nature is changeless
the pure Self, of peaceful form
the Self that is both calm and not calm
meaning.hi: शान्त और अशान्त स्वरूप वाली आत्मा

meaning.en: free of not-being-one
'the individual self, the supreme Self'
free of the whole stock of such thinking
meaning.hi: ऐसी चिन्ता के सर्वस्व से रहित

meaning.en: the Self that is both freed and unfreed
free of both freed and unfreed
the Self in the form of bondage and release
free of bondage and release
the Self in the form of two and not-two
free of two and not-two
the Self in the form of all and not-all
free of all and not-all
the Self in the form of joy and great joy
wholly free of joy and the rest
meaning.hi: मोद आदि से पूरी तरह रहित

meaning.en: the Self free of every intention
he is bodiless, truly free
the partless Self, the stainless Self
the awakened Self, whose nature is Purusha
the Self without bliss and the rest
the deathless Self, whose nature is deathlessness
the Self in the form of the three times
meaning.hi: तीनों कालों के रूप वाली आत्मा

meaning.en: free of the three times
the Self of the whole, the immeasurable Self
the Self that is the measure, free of measure
the Self whose form is always directly present
the always-direct certainty
the Self whose nature has no second
meaning.hi: अन्य से रहित स्वभाव वाली आत्मा

meaning.en: self-shining, without another
the Self to whom knowing and not-knowing are objects
free of knowing, not-knowing and the rest
the Self without the lasting and the passing
free of this world and the next
meaning.hi: इस लोक और परलोक से रहित

meaning.en: the Self empty of the six virtues beginning with calm
meaning.hi: शम आदि छह से शून्य आत्मा

meaning.en: free even of the longing for liberation
the Self without the gross body
free of the subtle body
the Self without the causal body and the rest
free even of the fourth and the rest
the Self without the sheath of food
free of the sheath of breath
the Self without the sheath of mind
free of the sheath of understanding and the rest
the Self without the sheath of bliss
free of all five sheaths
the Self whose nature has no distinctions
free of the state with distinctions
the Self without absorption mixed with the seen
free of absorption mixed with words
the Self always free of samadhi
without beginning, middle or end
meaning.hi: आदि, मध्य और अन्त से रहित

meaning.en: the Self without the saying 'awareness is Brahman'
free of 'I am Brahman'
the Self without 'You are That' and the rest
without the notion 'this Self'
the Self without what Om denotes
meaning.hi: ओंकार के वाच्य से रहित आत्मा

meaning.en: free of all that words denote
the Self without the three states
the imperishable Self, whose nature is awareness
the Self that is not a knowable object
meaning.hi: ज्ञेय आदि होने से रहित आत्मा

meaning.en: whatever this is, it is of the nature of the Self
meaning.hi: यह जो कुछ भी है, आत्म-स्वरूप है

meaning.en: the Self beyond appearing and not appearing
meaning.hi: भान और अभान से रहित आत्मा

meaning.en: he is bodiless, truly free
see only the Self
awaken to your own Self
enjoy your own Self by yourself
meaning.hi: अपनी आत्मा का स्वयं भोग करो

meaning.en: be established in yourself, O six-faced one
content in your own Self by yourself
move about in your own Self by yourself
rejoice in the Self alone
be bodiless and free: thus the Upanishad

words.sanskrit: nidagho nama vai munih papraccha ribhum

meaning.en: the sage named Nidagha asked Ribhu
meaning.hi: निदाघ नामक मुनि ने ऋभु से पूछा

meaning.en: teach me to tell the Self from the non-Self
Brahman is the limit of all speech, the guru the limit of all thought
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म सारी वाणी की सीमा, गुरु सारे विचार की सीमा

meaning.en: the Self of all cause and effect, yet free of both
meaning.hi: सारे कारण-कार्य की आत्मा, फिर भी दोनों से रहित

meaning.en: free of all intentions
made of all sound, the auspicious
awareness alone, free of everything
made of all bliss, the supreme
the Self that is the light of all radiance
whose nature is the bliss of sound
meaning.hi: नाद के आनन्द से बना स्वरूप

meaning.en: released from all experiences
free of all meditation
beyond all sounds and their fractions
meaning.hi: सारे नाद और कलाओं से परे

meaning.en: this Self, I, am imperishable
the sorting of Self from non-Self and the like
free of difference and non-difference
the Self without calm, unrest and the like
whose form is the inner light at the end of sound
meaning.hi: नाद के अन्त की भीतरी ज्योति-रूप

meaning.en: far from the meaning of the great sayings
very far from 'I am Brahman'
beyond the word 'That', without the word 'you'
meaning.hi: 'तत्' शब्द से परे, 'त्वम्' शब्द से रहित

meaning.en: free of the meaning of the sentence
who is free of the perishable and the imperishable
meaning.hi: जो क्षर और अक्षर से रहित है

meaning.en: he alone is the inner light at the end of sound
meaning.hi: वही नाद के अन्त की भीतरी ज्योति है

meaning.en: of undivided, single essence
free of the thought 'I am bliss'
the Self whose nature is beyond everything
he alone is the inner light at the end of sound
meaning.hi: वही नादान्त की भीतरी ज्योति है

meaning.en: who is without the word 'Self'
free of the meaning of the word 'Self'
meaning.hi: आत्मा शब्द के अर्थ से रहित

meaning.en: who is without being, awareness and bliss
this alone is the beginningless Self
he who cannot be pointed out
unreachable by the sentences of the Veda
for whom nothing is outside
and nothing, however small, inside
meaning.hi: और भीतर भी ज़रा-सा कुछ नहीं

meaning.en: whose sign, or whose manifold world
the Self is Brahman alone, no doubt
meaning.hi: आत्मा ब्रह्म ही है, सन्देह नहीं

words.sanskrit: na asti yasya shariram va jivo va

meaning.en: who has no body, nor individual soul
meaning.hi: जिसका न शरीर है, न जीव

meaning.en: the elements and what they make
there is no name, form and the rest
neither the enjoyed nor the enjoyer

words.sanskrit: sad va asad va sthitir va api

meaning.en: neither being nor non-being, nor any state
meaning.hi: न सत्, न असत्, न कोई स्थिति

meaning.en: for whom there is no perishable or imperishable
whether with qualities or without
meaning.hi: गुण सहित हो या गुण रहित

meaning.en: the Self is the same, no doubt
for whom there is neither denoted nor denoting
meaning.hi: जिसके लिए न वाच्य, न वाचक

meaning.en: nor hearing, nor reflection
the split of teacher, disciple and the like
worlds of the gods, gods and demons
where there is neither right nor wrong
nor pure or impure, even an atom
meaning.hi: न शुद्ध न अशुद्ध, अणु भर भी

meaning.en: where there is neither time nor non-time
surely neither certainty nor doubt
where there is neither mantra nor non-mantra
knowledge and ignorance are not found
seer, seeing or seen
even a sliver made of parts
any occasion for 'non-Self'

words.sanskrit: hi anatma iti mano api va

meaning.en: nor even a mind that thinks 'non-Self'
even the world as 'non-Self'
is not, is not: be certain
meaning.hi: नहीं है, नहीं है: निश्चय करो

meaning.en: because it is empty of every intention
meaning.hi: सारे संकल्पों से शून्य होने से

meaning.en: because it is free of every act
meaning.hi: सारे कार्यों से रहित होने से

meaning.en: because there is only Brahman
be certain: there is no non-Self
because it is without the three bodies
meaning.hi: तीनों देहों से रहित होने से

meaning.en: because it is free of the three times
meaning.hi: तीनों कालों से रहित होने से

meaning.en: because the qualities of the three experiencers are absent
meaning.hi: तीनों जीवों के गुणों के अभाव से

meaning.en: because it is free of the three afflictions
meaning.hi: तीनों तापों से रहित होने से

meaning.en: because it is without the three worlds
meaning.hi: तीनों लोकों से रहित होने से

meaning.en: because the teaching says all is the Self
with no mind, nothing to think about
meaning.hi: चित्त के अभाव से चिन्तनीय नहीं

meaning.en: with no body, no old age
meaning.hi: देह के अभाव से जरा नहीं

meaning.en: with no feet, no movement
meaning.hi: पैरों के अभाव से गति नहीं

meaning.en: with no hands, no action
meaning.hi: हाथों के अभाव से क्रिया नहीं

meaning.en: no death, since there is no birth
meaning.hi: जन्म के अभाव से मृत्यु नहीं

meaning.en: with no intellect, no pleasure and the rest
meaning.hi: बुद्धि के अभाव से सुख आदि नहीं

meaning.en: no duty, no purity
no truth, and no fear
there is no uttering of syllables
nor teacher, disciple and the rest
with no one, no second
meaning.hi: एक के अभाव में दूसरा नहीं

meaning.en: with no second, no oneness either
meaning.hi: दूसरे के बिना एकता भी नहीं

meaning.en: if there is any reality
then unreality cannot be possible
if unreality were to exist
reality would not come about
if auspicious, know inauspicious too
meaning.hi: यदि शुभ है, तो अशुभ भी जानो

meaning.en: for auspicious is posited from inauspicious
meaning.hi: क्योंकि अशुभ से ही शुभ माना जाता है

meaning.en: if fear, know its absence too
meaning.hi: यदि भय है, तो उसका अभाव भी जानो

meaning.en: fear falls out of fearlessness
meaning.hi: अभय से ही भय आ पड़ता है

meaning.en: if there is bondage, there is liberation
meaning.hi: यदि बन्धन है, तो मोक्ष है

meaning.en: with no bondage, where is liberation?
meaning.hi: बन्धन के अभाव में मोक्ष कहाँ?

meaning.en: if there is death, there was birth
meaning.hi: यदि मरण है, तो जन्म है

meaning.en: with no birth, no death either
meaning.hi: जन्म के अभाव में मृत्यु भी नहीं

words.sanskrit: tvam iti api bhavec ca aham

meaning.en: if there is 'you', there will be 'I'

words.sanskrit: tvam no ced aham eva na

meaning.en: if no 'you', then no 'I'
if 'this', then 'that' exists
without 'that', no 'this'
if 'it is', then 'it is not' too
if 'it is not', then something is
if there is an effect, there is some cause
meaning.hi: यदि कार्य है, तो कोई कारण है

meaning.en: with no effect, no cause
meaning.hi: कार्य के अभाव में कारण नहीं

meaning.en: if duality, then non-duality
without duality, not even the pair
meaning.hi: द्वैत के अभाव में द्वय भी नहीं

meaning.en: if there is the seen, there is the seer
meaning.hi: यदि दृश्य है, तो दृक् भी है

meaning.en: without the seen, no seer
meaning.hi: दृश्य के अभाव में दृक् भी नहीं

meaning.en: if the inner is real, the outer is real
meaning.hi: यदि भीतर सत्य है, तो बाहर भी

meaning.en: without the inner, no outer
meaning.hi: भीतर के अभाव में बाहर भी नहीं

meaning.en: if there is any fullness
non-fullness necessarily follows
therefore none of this is anywhere

words.sanskrit: tvam ca aham va ime idam

meaning.en: you and I, these, this
in the truth there is no example
in the unborn, nothing to be illustrated
'I am the supreme Brahman'
there is no mind for such remembering
meaning.hi: ऐसे स्मरण के लिए मन नहीं ही

meaning.en: this world is Brahman alone
you are Brahman alone, and I too
meaning.hi: तुम भी केवल ब्रह्म, मैं भी

meaning.en: I am awareness alone
be certain there is no non-Self
this world simply is not
never born, never staying anywhere
they say the mind is the world
meaning.hi: वे कहते हैं: चित्त ही प्रपञ्च है

meaning.en: it is not, not at all, ever
meaning.hi: नहीं है, बिल्कुल नहीं, कभी नहीं

meaning.en: no world, no mind and the rest
no ego, no little soul
there are no effects of maya and the rest
there is no maya, surely no fear
no doer, no action
no hearing, no reflection
there is no pair of samadhis
surely no knower, means of knowing and the rest
and there is no ignorance at all
nor lack of discernment, ever
no fourfold preliminaries
nor the three kinds of relation
no Ganga, no Gaya, no Setu
meaning.hi: न गंगा, न गया, न सेतु

words.sanskrit: na bhutam na anyad asti hi

meaning.en: no being, and nothing else at all
meaning.hi: न भूत, न और कुछ ही
